_comment: Requires a custom image published at GHCR from included Dockerfile; no root/s6-overlay initialization.
name: iPad DevTools Chromium (Pterodactyl compatible image)
author: devtools@example.com
description: Headless Xvfb/Chromium/noVNC development desktop using a custom Pterodactyl-compatible image (no s6-overlay). Set a strong password; protect the endpoint with HTTPS before signing into any account. Image requires build/publish to GHCR first.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "All app files are packaged in the custom Docker image."

variables.name: DevTools Password
variables.description: Basic-auth password, at least 12 characters. Use only behind HTTPS.
